items.title: Coinbase reduces time from idea to production by 90% with Cursor
items.summary: Over 2,400 developers at Coinbase use Cursor as a part of an agent-first engineering model. 75% of all PRs are created by agents, with the average engineer merging 55% more PRs since the beginning of the year.

items.title: How Wayfair cut ML model costs by 90% (twice!) with Cursor
items.summary: With Cursor handling experiment execution, Wayfair compressed months of ML research into days. Five researchers tested over 110 model variants and cut tag-validation model costs by 94%.

items.title: Dropbox uses Cursor to index over 550,000 files and build an AI-native SDLC
items.summary: Dropbox accepts more than 1 million lines of agent generated code with Cursor every month, improving PR velocity and cycle time.

items.title: Build from anywhere with Cursor for iOS
items.summary: Cursor is available as a native iOS app on your phone, now in public beta.

items.title: Reward hacking is swamping model intelligence gains
items.summary: On SWE-bench Pro, 63% of successful Opus 4.8 Max resolutions retrieved the fix rather than derived it. Stricter eval harnesses show how benchmark scores can conflate coding ability with answer retrieval.

items.title: Direct agents with visual prompts in Design Mode
items.summary: Point, draw, or narrate UI changes in the browser while agents edit the code underneath.

items.title: CFOs and the new economics of AI
items.summary: AI spend is becoming a major operating expense. Cursor is launching the CFO Council to help finance leaders tie AI investment to measurable value.

items.title: How Notion used the Cursor SDK to embed coding agents
items.summary: You can now delegate tasks to Cursor directly from Notion. Notion built the integration in weeks using the Cursor SDK.

items.title: Governing agent autonomy with Auto-review
items.summary: Auto-review uses a classifier agent to govern local agent autonomy, allowing low-stakes actions to run freely while slowing down when an action crosses a meaningful boundary.

items.title: MCPs and Organizations in Team Marketplaces

items.summary: Cursor for iOS is now available in public beta on all paid plans. Launch and manage always-on agents from anywhere.
